vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who has big round eyes, and soft fluffy feathers?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who says: hoo, hoo? Can you guess?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's... an owl!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Hoo-hoo! Hello! I'm Oliver the owl!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, Oliver! I'm Super Bobo!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: And I'm Bella!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What does an owl say?

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Hoo-hoo! Hoo-hoo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you hoot like Oliver? Your turn!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Hoo-hoo!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's learn three owl facts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact one. Most owls are awake at night, and they sleep in the day.

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Yaaawn! That's why I'm a little sleepy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact two. Owls can turn their heads very, very far. Almost all the way around!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Look left... look right... I can see behind me!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact three. Owl feathers are so soft, owls can fly very, very quietly. Shhh!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Wow! Owls are amazing!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But Oliver has a little problem.

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: All my owl friends can fly. But I never flew before. I'm scared!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oliver feels scared. His tummy feels wobbly.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How can his friends help Oliver?

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: I know! Friends help friends! Let's practice, one step at a time!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Step one. Flap your wings! Flap, flap, flap!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you flap your wings like Oliver? Your turn!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Flap, flap, flap! I'm doing it!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Step two. A little hop, from the low branch!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: I made a soft pile of leaves for you!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Here I go... hop!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Boing! Oliver lands in the soft leaves.

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: I did it! That was fun!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Step three. Back up on the big branch. We count to three, and you fly!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: I'm a little scared... but my friends are here.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's count together! One... two... three!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Flap, flap... I'm flying! Wheee!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Hooray! You can fly, Oliver!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oliver flies over the trees, quietly, like a feather.

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Thank you, friends! You helped me be brave!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oh no! Bella's red balloon floats away, and gets stuck in a tall tree!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: My balloon! It's too high!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who can help Bella? Can you guess?

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: I can! I can fly now! Friends help friends!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Oliver flies up... up... and gets the balloon!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Here you go, Bella!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Thank you, Oliver! You're a good friend!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Friends help friends. And together, we can be brave!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now the moon comes out. It's night time, and owls are awake!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Hoo-hoo! Night is my favorite time!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now, let's play and remember, with Oliver!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When are most owls awake? In the day, or at night?

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: At night!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Why can owls fly so quietly?

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Their feathers are so soft!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you turn your head like an owl? Look left... look right!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Great looking!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What were the three steps to fly?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Flap your wings,

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: a little hop,

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: and count to three!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who helped Bella get her balloon?

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Oliver!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's say it together!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Friends help friends!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Friends help friends!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: One more time, all together!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Friends help friends!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's flap and fly with Oliver! Flap, flap, flap!

vo.speaker: oliver
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Hoo-hoo!

vo.speaker: bella
vo.text: Bye-bye!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How can YOU help a friend today?
